## Common JOIN Patterns

该表作为维度查找表，始终通过 `entrance` 列 LEFT OUTER JOIN：

```sql
LEFT OUTER JOIN
(
    select entrance, common_feature
    from mp_paidads.dim_common_feature_mapping_v2__reg_s0_live
) common_feature_mapping1
ON ads_base.entrance = common_feature_mapping1.entrance
```

- 14/14 个文件均使用相同模式
- 无分区过滤（dim 表全表扫描）
- 仅选取 `entrance` 和 `common_feature` 两列

## Representative SQL Snippets

### 1. 基础维度映射（deprecated workflow，多地域统一模式）

```sql
select
    user_id, entrance, placement,
    coalesce(common_feature_mapping1.common_feature, 'Others') as common_feature,
    pricing_type,
    sum(ads_revenue_local) as ads_revenue_local
from mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live ads_base
LEFT OUTER JOIN
(
    select entrance, common_feature
    from mp_paidads.dim_common_feature_mapping_v2__reg_s0_live
) common_feature_mapping1
ON ads_base.entrance = common_feature_mapping1.entrance
where ads_base.grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
    and ads_base.grass_region = upper('${region}')
    and ads_base.tz_type = 'local'
group by user_id, entrance, placement, common_feature, pricing_type
```

### 2. 带 Platform 后备值的用户级别实验分析

```sql
select ads_base.grass_region, user_id, placement, shop_id,
    coalesce(common_feature_mapping1.common_feature, 'Others') as common_feature,
    app_version, ads_base.item_id, location
from ads_base_info ads_base
LEFT OUTER JOIN
(
    select entrance, common_feature
    from mp_paidads.dim_common_feature_mapping_v2__reg_s0_live
) common_feature_mapping1
ON ads_base.entrance = common_feature_mapping1.entrance

union all

select ads_base.grass_region, user_id, placement, shop_id,
    'Platform' as common_feature,
    app_version, ads_base.item_id, location
from ads_base_info ads_base
-- No join to mapping table; Platform is hardcoded
```

### 3. 用户-商品级别 PC2 分析（playground）

```sql
select grass_date, user_id, item_id,
    coalesce(common_feature, 'Others') as common_feature,
    expenditure_amt_usd, broad_gmv_amt_usd
from (
    select grass_date, user_id, item_id, entrance,
        expenditure_amt_usd, broad_gmv_amt_usd
    from mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live
    where grass_date between date('${grass_date_30day}') and date('${grass_date}')
        and grass_region = upper('${region}')
        and (expenditure_amt_usd>0 or broad_gmv_amt_usd>0)
) ads_base
left outer join (
    select entrance, common_feature
    from mp_paidads.dim_common_feature_mapping_v2__reg_s0_live
) common_feature_mapping1 on ads_base.entrance = common_feature_mapping1.entrance
```
